boredom.title: Why a boredom meter?
paragraphs: In psychology, boredom is not laziness. It is the signal that a routine has stopped paying off and that it is time to look for something new (Westgate & Wilson 2018; Eastwood et al. 2012; Bench & Lench 2013).

Caffeinated turns that signal into a measured quantity B between 0 and 1 that steers the swarm. B is high when recent attempts mean the same thing as earlier ones, when nothing has significantly improved for a while, and when attempts keep failing or repeating.

It is never an LLM opinion: B is a deterministic function of the experiment ledger, so any agent can recompute any other agent's boredom and check it. It combines novelty, stagnation and overload (B = 0.45·(1 − novelty) + 0.45·stagnation + 0.10·overload).
